SEARCH
Package restaurant

Class RestaurantRushApp

java.lang.Object
restaurant.RestaurantRushApp
public class RestaurantRushApp extends Object
Entry point and turn controller for Restaurant Rush This class owns the shared game state (waiting queue, tables, orders, cashier queue and statistics) It also gives references to the Waiter, Chef, Cashier and GameUI so they all work on the same objects Each turn runs in this order: 1. Arrivals (Customers showing up on preset turns) 2. Waiter then Chef actions chosen by the manager 3. Cashier payment 4. Eating advances (Customers served on the previous turn start eating) 5. Waiting satisfaction loss and abandonment 6. Tables are freed After the final turn displays whether or not the player wins
